purpose: Versioned small-stake forward evidence for CFB leans, with a per-market concentration cap. Not validation, not OFFICIAL, not Model_P certification.
requires: bet_status == LEAN (already cleared edge floor/cap, positive push-aware ROI, paired devig, -165 cap, same-game guard)
model_status == MODEL_SDV_PUBLIC_LIVE_UNVALIDATED or MODEL (never market-only fallback)
TOTAL side is not in the direction of the slate's detected model total bias (audit_cfb_sdv_total_bias)
SPREAD/MONEYLINE rows use the market-anchored margin and passed its forward-track threshold
ranking: edge descending; ties by expected_roi; max 8 per slate and max 5 of each market type
promotion_rule: Review after 100 graded probation bets: promote a market to standard stakes only if mean no-vig CLV > 0 with t >= 2.0; ROI is a sanity check only.
kill_rule: After 50 graded bets in a market, stop that market if mean no-vig CLV < 0 with t <= -1.5, or after 100 graded bets if mean CLV <= 0.
never: change thresholds after seeing results without a new policy version
